name: Brick & Build — 30-Day Lead Digest to Owner
notes: SETUP: 1) Points at the same Google Sheet as workflow 1 — paste the same Sheet ID. 2) Open the Gmail node, connect the owner's Gmail account (or swap for a WhatsApp/SMS node if you'd rather get the digest that way), and replace OWNER_EMAIL_HERE@example.com with the real address. 3) Activate this workflow — it will run automatically every 30 days and email a plain-text summary of that period's leads. Swap the Schedule Trigger's interval if you want a different cadence (e.g. weekly).
